module Splice.Scripts.TestValidatorOnboarding where

import Daml.Script
import DA.Assert
import DA.Time

import Splice.ValidatorOnboarding

testValidatorOnboarding : Script ()
testValidatorOnboarding = do

  -- allocate the sponsoring sv
  sv <- allocateParty "sv"

  -- sv creates an onboarding offer
  let secret = "test"
  now <- getTime
  onboarding <- submit sv $ createCmd (ValidatorOnboarding sv secret (addRelTime now (days 2)))

  -- The secret and the party ID of sv (the onboarding sponsor)
  -- reaches the validator candidate via a secure off-ledger channel.

  -- The candidate sets up his participant and allocates a validator party.
  validator <- allocateParty "validator"

  -- The candidate contacts the SV node via an API call and presents his secret.

  -- As a result of the API call, the SV node matches the secret to the prepared validator onboarding.
  _ <- submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd onboarding $ (ValidatorOnboarding_Match "typo" validator)
  _ <- submit sv $ exerciseCmd onboarding $ (ValidatorOnboarding_Match "test" validator)

  [(_, usedSecret)] <- query @UsedSecret sv
  usedSecret.secret === secret
  usedSecret.validator === validator

  -- sv can now onboard the validator with the authority granted it via the `DsoRules`
  return ()


testValidatorOnboardingExpire : Script ()
testValidatorOnboardingExpire = do

  sv <- allocateParty "sv"
  validator <- allocateParty "validator"

  let secret = "test"
  now <- getTime
  onboarding <- submit sv $ createCmd (ValidatorOnboarding sv secret (addRelTime now (days 2)))

  _ <- submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd onboarding $ (ValidatorOnboarding_Expire)

  passTime(days 2)

  _ <- submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd onboarding $ (ValidatorOnboarding_Match "test" validator)
  _ <- submit sv $ exerciseCmd onboarding $ (ValidatorOnboarding_Expire)

  return ()

module Splice.Scripts.TestValidatorOnboarding where

import DA.Assert
import DA.Time
import Daml.Script

import Splice.ValidatorOnboarding

testMatchSecretAndValidator : Script ()
testMatchSecretAndValidator = do
  sv <- allocateParty "sponsor"
  validator <- allocateParty "validator"
  otherValidator <- allocateParty "otherValidator"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` hours 1
  offerCid <- submit sv $ createCmd ValidatorOnboarding with
    candidateSecret = "correct-secret"
    ..

  submitMustFail validator $ exerciseCmd offerCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "correct-secret"
    ..
  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd offerCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "incorrect-secret"
    ..
  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd offerCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "correct-secret "
    ..
  Some offer <- queryContractId @ValidatorOnboarding sv offerCid
  offer === ValidatorOnboarding with
    candidateSecret = "correct-secret"
    ..

  ValidatorOnboarding_MatchResult usedSecretCid <- submit sv $ exerciseCmd offerCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "correct-secret"
    ..
  None <- queryContractId @ValidatorOnboarding sv offerCid
  Some usedSecret <- queryContractId @UsedSecret sv usedSecretCid
  usedSecret === UsedSecret with
    secret = "correct-secret"
    ..
  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd offerCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "correct-secret"
    validator = otherValidator
  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd offerCid ValidatorOnboarding_Expire

testDeadlineBoundary : Script ()
testDeadlineBoundary = do
  sv <- allocateParty "deadlineSponsor"
  validator <- allocateParty "deadlineValidator"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` hours 1
  beforeCid <- submit sv $ createCmd ValidatorOnboarding with
    candidateSecret = "before"
    ..
  atCid <- submit sv $ createCmd ValidatorOnboarding with
    candidateSecret = "at"
    ..
  afterCid <- submit sv $ createCmd ValidatorOnboarding with
    candidateSecret = "after"
    ..

  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd beforeCid ValidatorOnboarding_Expire
  submitMustFail validator $ exerciseCmd beforeCid ValidatorOnboarding_Expire
  setTime (expiresAt `addRelTime` negate (seconds 1))
  ValidatorOnboarding_MatchResult beforeUsedCid <- submit sv $ exerciseCmd beforeCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "before"
    ..
  Some _ <- queryContractId @UsedSecret sv beforeUsedCid

  setTime expiresAt
  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd atCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "at"
    ..
  Some _ <- queryContractId @ValidatorOnboarding sv atCid
  submitMustFail validator $ exerciseCmd atCid ValidatorOnboarding_Expire
  ValidatorOnboarding_ExpireResult <- submit sv $ exerciseCmd atCid ValidatorOnboarding_Expire
  None <- queryContractId @ValidatorOnboarding sv atCid
  [] <- queryFilter @UsedSecret sv (\used -> used.secret == "at")

  setTime (expiresAt `addRelTime` seconds 1)
  submitMustFail sv $ exerciseCmd afterCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "after"
    ..
  ValidatorOnboarding_ExpireResult <- submit sv $ exerciseCmd afterCid ValidatorOnboarding_Expire
  None <- queryContractId @ValidatorOnboarding sv afterCid
  pure ()

testIndependentOffers : Script ()
testIndependentOffers = do
  firstSponsor <- allocateParty "firstSponsor"
  secondSponsor <- allocateParty "secondSponsor"
  firstValidator <- allocateParty "firstValidator"
  secondValidator <- allocateParty "secondValidator"
  now <- getTime
  let expiresAt = now `addRelTime` hours 1
  firstCid <- submit firstSponsor $ createCmd ValidatorOnboarding with
    sv = firstSponsor
    candidateSecret = "shared-secret"
    ..
  secondCid <- submit secondSponsor $ createCmd ValidatorOnboarding with
    sv = secondSponsor
    candidateSecret = "shared-secret"
    ..
  ValidatorOnboarding_MatchResult firstUsedCid <- submit firstSponsor $ exerciseCmd firstCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "shared-secret"
    validator = firstValidator
  ValidatorOnboarding_MatchResult secondUsedCid <- submit secondSponsor $ exerciseCmd secondCid ValidatorOnboarding_Match with
    providedSecret = "shared-secret"
    validator = secondValidator
  Some firstUsed <- queryContractId @UsedSecret firstSponsor firstUsedCid
  firstUsed === UsedSecret with
    sv = firstSponsor
    secret = "shared-secret"
    validator = firstValidator
  Some secondUsed <- queryContractId @UsedSecret secondSponsor secondUsedCid
  secondUsed === UsedSecret with
    sv = secondSponsor
    secret = "shared-secret"
    validator = secondValidator

Added three Daml Script tests in `daml/splice-validator-lifecycle-test/daml/Splice/Scripts/TestValidatorOnboarding.daml:1`. They cover secret matching, sponsor authorization, contract consumption and `UsedSecret` contents, expiry before and at the deadline, and independent offers.

All three scripts compile and pass against the current implementation.
